target_profile.system_boundary: The repository Go raft package, including replication and lease consumers plus built-in storage and transport variants. Application FSM and deployment adapter selection remain caller responsibilities; built-in implementations are inside the available audit boundary.
protocol_contexts: Raft current term and per-follower replication currentTerm
Peer ServerID/address and latest configuration voter membership
ownership: replicate launches a separate heartbeat goroutine for a followerReplication object
checkLeaderLease is owned by the main Raft thread
NewRaft restores current term and last log through injected stores
selection_injection: NewRaft receives all five interfaces from its caller; no deployed adapter choice is supplied.
NetworkTransport selects an injected stream and timeout; InmemTransport has its own queue and timeout.
variants: Ordinary AppendEntries and pipelined AppendEntries response processing
Pre-vote disabled by configuration or missing WithPreVote transport capability
Built-in InmemStore, InmemSnapshotStore and FileSnapshotStore constructors; their failure semantics remain unexpanded
NetworkTransport and InmemTransport; the latter does not support heartbeat fast-path registration
unknowns: Concrete deployed configuration, adapters and FSM are unspecified.

activities.purpose: Authority maintenance and interpretation of peer responses
activities.realization_summary: Heartbeat response completion feeds the lease connectivity consumer; stale AppendEntries rejection has been read separately.
unknowns: Election, transfer, full step-down and verification completion paths remain partial.

activities.realization_summary: Successful ordinary/pipelined responses call updateLastAppended, which reports match index to commitment; decision aggregation is not yet recovered.
unknowns: commitment.match and decision consumers remain unread.

activities.realization_summary: Leader loop converts counted verification support into successful future completion; public API describes prevention of stale data after leadership loss.
unknowns: Application read ordering, FSM freshness, future delivery and shutdown paths remain partial.

behaviors.execution_owner: Per-follower heartbeat goroutine launched by replicate
behaviors.protocol_context: One followerReplication object with fixed request term s.currentTerm; peer address read under peerLock on each iteration
legal_preconditions: replicate has started this heartbeat worker
implementation_guards: Transport errors enter backoff without refreshing contact
important_branches: Any error-free response refreshes contact without a response-term comparison
An unsuccessful response still refreshes contact but supplies false to notifyAll
existing_protections: Verification notification uses response Success, not mere RPC completion
Ordinary replication separately detects newer response terms
unknowns: Transport response production, timing and cancellation under network fast path need exact reading.

behaviors.protocol_context: Latest configuration voter set and current leaderState replication objects
implementation_guards: Counts remote timestamps only within leaseTimeout
writes: Raft state becomes Follower if recent contacted voters are below quorum
unknowns: Other contact producers and replication object replacement are not fully mapped.
This consumer establishes a connectivity decision; stronger authority validity is not established by its timestamp check.

behaviors.protocol_context: Receiver current term exceeds request term
external_effects: Respond with current term, Success=false, and nil RPC error
unknowns: Concurrent fast-path execution and its dispatch restrictions need investigation.

behaviors.protocol_context: One verifyFuture object with nonnil notifyCh and threshold initialized by verifyLeader
behaviors.trigger: A positive vote call while this future remains active
legal_preconditions: verifyLeader initialized self-vote, quorumSize and notifyCh for a multi-voter configuration
A replication notification dispatcher captured this future in its pending set
implementation_guards: Threshold notification is sent only when votes >= quorumSize
writes: Clear v.notifyCh after sending threshold notification
external_effects: Send the same future pointer to main-thread verifyCh
async_boundaries: Channel send while voteLock is held
Pending-set capture in notifyAll happens under a separate lock
unknowns: Full provenance and time of each supporting peer response are not represented by vote parameters.
Negative-vote notifications follow a separate branch and do not establish this positive-threshold fact.
Other response producers, configurations and replication-object lifetimes are only partially read.

behaviors.protocol_context: Received verification future with nonzero quorumSize and votes >= quorumSize
behaviors.trigger: Receive future pointer from verifyCh in leader loop
implementation_guards: Zero quorumSize routes to initial registration
Below-threshold notification routes to ErrNotLeader and Follower transition
writes: Remove future from leaderState.notify and all follower pending sets

cross_activity_effects.A2: Interprets threshold support as continued leadership for this verification operation.

unknowns: Future.Error delivery and all leader-loop exits have not been expanded.
Successful verification does not itself apply the FSM or observe a client read.

facts.meaning: For this replication object, a heartbeat AppendEntries RPC completed without a transport error and refreshed contact time. This does not assert acceptance of the sender as leader or successful log replication.

identity.peer: peer identity read for this RPC

facts.validity_context: Volatile contact observation for the same replication object; lease consumer bounds age separately.
facts.durability: Volatile timestamp protected by lastContactLock; no persistence claimed.
facts.recovery: No recovery semantics established; initialization and object replacement remain unread.
unknowns: Other timestamp producers exist and are not included as producers of this heartbeat-specific fact.
Address/configuration replacement and initial contact assignments remain to be mapped.

facts.meaning: For this verifyFuture object, positive vote calls have raised its counter to at least the threshold captured at registration, and that object has been sent to the verification result channel. This states counted support, not freshness or correctness of peer authority.
facts.validity_context: One active multi-voter verification object; positive branch under voteLock before notifyCh is cleared.
facts.recovery: No restoration of this future established; leader-exit cancellation remains unexpanded.
unknowns: Upstream peer response production and registration-relative age need mapping.
Membership and term are not fields on verifyFuture; lifetime protection requires separate reading.
